videos.title: Why Signals Are Better Than React Hooks
videos.description: Discover why Signals offer a more intuitive and performant alternative to traditional React Hooks for state management. This guide explores the common pitfalls of Hooks, such as complex rules and unnecessary re-renders, and demonstrates how to solve them using the Preact Signals…

videos.title: Should You Use Signals with React?
videos.description: Explore the concept of signals in React and learn how they enable fine-grained reactivity to boost application performance and simplify state management. This video breaks down React's unidirectional data flow and contrasts it with the targeted updates provided by signals…

videos.title: Switching from React to Preact (Server-side Rendering with JavaScript Frameworks)
videos.description: This video explores migrating a server-side rendered React application to Preact, a lightweight alternative, focusing on the performance benefits derived from its smaller library size and optimizing data fetching to eliminate redundant HTTP requests for JSON data.

videos.title: What is Preact? (the best small React alternative)
videos.description: This video introduces Preact, a JavaScript framework with a React-compatible API, highlighting its suitability for mobile and embedded environments. It covers Preact's architecture, advantages, and use cases as a lightweight alternative to React.

videos.title: JS frameworks are replaceable
videos.description: This video offers an overview of Preact, comparing it to React, focusing on routing, state management, JSX, Virtual DOM, and rendering. It teaches how to work with Preact.

videos.title: Preact Vs React JS
videos.description: This video compares Preact and React, analyzing their file sizes, virtual DOM implementations, and performance claims. It discusses Preact's supposed advantages in speed and footprint, alongside its differences in event handling and component availability compared to React.
